# x402 CSV Normalizer

> Clean messy CSV, TSV, or delimiter-separated text into reliable structured data. Perfect for agents ingesting user uploads or scraped tables.

## Free
- GET /catalog
- GET /api/normalize (metadata)

## Paid
POST /api/normalize
Body: { "text": "...", "options"?: { "header": true, "output": "json" | "csv" } }

Price ~0.008 USDC

Uses standard x402 payment flow.
